description: One model that wrote data to the artifact. It declares its axes once and lists the datasets and tables that use them.

name.description: Model name. It is unique in the document and names the HDF5 group of the model.

model_type.description: Kind of model that wrote the data. Readers dispatch on this field.

system_uuid.description: UUID of the system that the model ran on. It is a key of the document systems object.

base_power.description: Base power of the model in MVA. Readers use it for each dataset with base_reference system.

supports_realized_values_post_calculatio.description: True when PowerAnalytics can join the datasets of the model across executions into one time axis. The join keeps the first interval/resolution horizon steps of each execution. A model with a time axis sets it to false.

settings.description: Settings that a reader needs to interpret the data. Each value is a string, a number, or a boolean.

axes.description: Every axis that a dataset of the model uses. Each axis has a name that its kind and fields define. Axis names are unique in the model.

tables.description: Column sets of the model, such as optimizer statistics.
